name: vip-mobiles
description: VIP Mobiles - Mobile Store E-commerce & Management Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run sync-standalone && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/db && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
